text: AGINT 智进是面向 DSH 的智能体扩展框架，通过 bundle patch 挂载多个 Cordis 插件和 preset。已读实现包括长期记忆的读写、筛选与搜索，带持久状态的定时任务服务，以及汇总工具调用次数、失败率和延迟的 tool_stats_summary。适合希望为 DSH 增加记忆、后台调度和运行观测能力的用户；安装后需重启目标 profile。

AGINT extends DSH with Cordis plugins for persistent memory, scheduled jobs, and tool usage reporting. Inspected modules support memory search, job state recovery, and summaries of tool call counts, failures, and latency. Restart the target profile after installation.
我想让 DSH 记住过去会话里积累的经验和偏好
能不能按关键词搜索已经保存的智能体记忆？
我需要在 DSH 里配置定时任务并查看运行状态
让 DSH 定期运行后台任务，并保留每次执行结果。
I want my DSH agent to retain and search useful memories.
I need scheduled background jobs in my DSH setup.
AGINT 的记忆搜索功能：按内容或证据关键词查找记忆，可按类型筛选并限制结果数量；结果按有效置信度排序。
AGINT 的记忆写入功能：将带类型、内容、级别和置信度的条目保存到持久化 memory 表，并在更新时保留已有状态字段。
AGINT 的定时任务服务：加载任务并周期性触发调度，同时从存储中恢复任务上次运行时间、结果和错误状态。
AGINT 的工具使用摘要：调用 tool_stats_summary 查询工具调用次数、失败率、平均延迟和 p95 延迟，并可按时间窗口限制摘要。
AGINT 作为 DSH bundle 安装后需要重启目标 profile，bundle 与 profile 层不会热更新。
我想查看工具使用表现，找出失败率较高的调用。
Can DSH retain job results and report tool performance?

|---|---|---|
| **bundle** | 整体 = dsh bundle 包 `@agint/host`（全部插件 + 挂载 patch） | `package.json` + `cordis.patch.yml` |
| **preset** | 智进人格 + 工具集 + skills，1 套：`agint`（主线） | `presets/agint/` |
| **plugin** | 41 个 Cordis 插件（37 条挂载声明），8 组（记忆 / 调度 / 反思 / 质量 / 闭环 / 执行 / 观测 / 感知），清单见 [`docs/plugins/`](./docs/plugins/) | `plugins/agint-*/` |
| **data** | 记忆 / 规则 / 指标 / 梦境 / 复盘 | runtime 数据，不进仓库 |

@agint/host README · 四层结构：> **子 preset 不在本仓**：`agint-blockchain` / `agint-investor` / `agint-ops` 三套
> 是个人定制（差别只有人格、路由、技能库），2026-10-26 起拆到私有仓
> `agint-presets`，以独立 bundle `@agint/presets` 交付。它们复用本仓的
> `agint-*` 插件，所以要先装本仓再装那个。

@agint/host README · 安装：前置：Node.js ≥ 20 · python3 · dsh ≥ 0.1.7-rc.1（矩阵见 [`VERSION`](./VERSION)）· 目标 profile 已初始化（web 跑过一次 `dsh web`，desktop 启动过一次桌面版）。

```sh
git clone https://github.com/Anmulzhao/DSH-AGINT.git ~/projects/AGINT
cd ~/projects/AGINT
./install/install.sh --profile=web      # 默认 web；装进桌面 profile 写 --profile=desktop
```

装完**必须重启目标 profile**（web 重开 `dsh web`；desktop 退出并重开桌面版）——bundle 与 profile 层不热更新。卸载 `./install/uninstall.sh`。

@agint/host README · 安装：> **一份 preset 服务所有 profile**：`$DSH_HOME/.agent-presets/agint/` 只有一份，
> web 与 desktop 共用。它的 25 行工具声明因此锚定 `.agint-bundle/plugins/`
> （bundle 主挂载源），**不随 `--profile` 变化** —— 装完 web 再装 desktop
> 不会把先装的那端指空。安装器逐条核验这 25 个目标存在，缺一个即报。

四条红线：

@agint/host README · 安装：1. 升级 dsh 必须带精确版本号——`npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@latest` 会静默降级。
2. 包内 `node_modules` junction 是指向 dsh 官方包的软链；`rm -rf` 会跟进删包，卸载时必须保留。
3. 装完像没装、零报错，十有八九是没注册进 `dsh.profile.bundles`（安装步骤 3.5）。
4. `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `!!js` 只能写成标量。写成块集合或模板会让整份 bundle patch 解析失败，dsh 静默跳过 `@agint/host`，界面无报错——改完跑 `node bin/check-patch-yaml.mjs`。

更多排障见 [`docs/dsh-integration.md`](./docs/dsh-integration.md)；容器部署走 [`docker/`](./docker/)。

@agint/host README · 仓库自检：改完插件必跑四步：`node bin/check-patch-yaml.mjs`（patch YAML 可解析）→ `node bin/check-wiring.mjs`（接线通电）→ `node bin/check-dsh-compat.mjs`（dsh 兼容）→ `node bin/check-boundary.mjs`（能力边界未越界）。其余自检（manifest / tool schema / 记忆层 / LOCAL-STATE 回写）用法见 `bin/` 下脚本。

@agint/host README · 文档地图：环境变量三个：`DSH_HOME`（dsh 数据根，默认 `$HOME/.dsh`）；`AGINT_PROFILE`（`install.sh` 的目标 profile 默认值，缺省 `web`）；`AGINT_HOME` **双语义**——`install.sh` 当源码根、插件侧当数据根，设错会把数据写进仓库目录（设计说明见 `docker/entrypoint.sh`）。

@agint/host README · Four layers：| Layer | Content | Location |
|---|---|---|
| **bundle** | The whole: the `dsh` bundle package `@agint/host` (all plugins plus mount patches) | `package.json` + `cordis.patch.yml` |
| **preset** | The Zhinjin (智进) persona, its tool set, and its skills; 1 preset: `agint` (main line) | `presets/agint/` |
| **plugin** | 40 Cordis plugins (36 mount declarations) in 8 groups (memory / scheduling / reflection / quality / closed loop / execution / observation / perception). List: [`docs/plugins/`](./docs/plugins/) | `plugins/agint-*/` |
| **data** | Memory / rules / metrics / dreams / reviews | Runtime data. It does not enter the repository. |

@agint/host README · Install：Prerequisites: Node.js ≥ 20 · python3 · `dsh` ≥ 0.1.7-rc.1 (matrix in [`VERSION`](./VERSION)) · the target profile is initialized (run `dsh web` once for web, or launch the desktop app once for desktop).

```sh
git clone https://github.com/Anmulzhao/DSH-AGINT.git ~/projects/AGINT
cd ~/projects/AGINT
./install/install.sh --profile=web      # web is the default; use --profile=desktop for the desktop profile
```

@agint/host README · Install：After the install, **restart the target profile** (re-open `dsh web`, or quit and re-open the desktop app). The bundle layer and the profile layer do not hot-reload. To remove AGINT, run `./install/uninstall.sh`.

@agint/host README · Install：> **One preset serves every profile**: `$DSH_HOME/.agent-presets/agint/` holds a
> single file set shared by web and desktop. Its 25 tool declarations therefore
> anchor to `.agint-bundle/plugins/` (the bundle's main mount source) and do
> **not** vary with `--profile` — installing web and then desktop will not point
> the first one at an empty directory. The installer verifies all 25 targets
> exist and reports any that are missing.

Four hard rules:

@agint/host README · Install：1. Always name the exact version when you upgrade `dsh`. `npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@latest` silently downgrades.
2. The `node_modules` entry inside the package is a junction to the official `dsh` package. `rm -rf` follows the link and deletes that package. Keep it when you uninstall.
3. If the install ends with no error but nothing looks installed, the bundle is most likely not registered in `dsh.profile.bundles` (install step 3.5).
4. `!!js` in `cordis.patch.yml` must be a scalar. A block collection or a template makes the whole bundle patch fail to parse. `dsh` then silently skips `@agint/host`, and the UI shows no error. Run `node bin/check-patch-yaml.mjs` after you edit the file.
@agint/host README · Install：For more troubleshooting, see [`docs/dsh-integration.md`](./docs/dsh-integration.md). For container deployment, use [`docker/`](./docker/).

@agint/host README · Repository self-checks：After you change a plugin, run four steps: `node bin/check-patch-yaml.mjs` (the patch YAML parses) → `node bin/check-wiring.mjs` (the wiring is live) → `node bin/check-dsh-compat.mjs` (`dsh` compatibility) → `node bin/check-boundary.mjs` (the capability boundary is clean). The other self-checks (manifest / tool schema / memory layer / LOCAL-STATE write-back) carry their own usage notes in the scripts under `bin/`.

@agint/host README · Documentation map：Docs under `docs/` are written in Chinese. This README is the only English entry point.

Three environment variables: `DSH_HOME` (the `dsh` data root, default `$HOME/.dsh`); `AGINT_PROFILE` (the default target profile for `install.sh`, `web` if unset); `AGINT_HOME`, which has **two meanings** — `install.sh` reads it as the source root, while plugins read it as the data root. Set it wrong and the system writes data into the repository directory. The design note is in `docker/entrypoint.sh`.
